The '''''Predominant''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] under commission by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The ''Predominant'' was [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]], who used it to tour the very edge of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was with him aboard the vessel when they took a trip to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], showing the Emperor the preparations for construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].
